description.en: Selection of lifting solution, correct volume (at least 5-10 mL), needle depth and angle, and dynamic injection to open the submucosa cleanly.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for submucosal injection technique but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs submucosal injection technique independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches submucosal injection technique to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
